originalEvidence.nativeVersion: Miro observed service 1.105564.0 / Web SDK v2 (unpinned)
knownOmissions: The native synthetic witness records 4x4 geometry. The clockwise order in the review is authored from the historical Miro composition, not inferred from those native coordinates.

Straight routing on each edge is an explicit review choice guided by the native witness and historical capture; combining it with circular placement is an authored synthesis, not an exact reproduction.
All 24 links retain their source direction and data kind; clockwise placement does not impose temporal order or causal meaning on those links.
Historical Miro, Google Slides, and LibreOffice outputs are based on Visual 1.1 source documents and do not establish support for the new Visual 1.4 circular layout.
originalEvidence.scope: Synthetic source witnesses and historical Visual 1.1 host outputs only. Circular placement is authored review intent; renderer support is separately qualified per Visual 1.4 output.
